schema:
CREATE TABLE items (item_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, category TEXT);
CREATE TABLE inspections (item_id INTEGER NOT NULL, inspection_date DATE NOT NULL, rating_code TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (item_id, inspection_date), FOREIGN KEY (item_id) REFERENCES items (item_id));
correct_query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.category FROM items AS T1 INNER JOIN inspections AS T2 ON T1.item_id = T2.item_id WHERE T2.rating_code >= 8
